children: Game Your Game announced full commercial availability of its GameGolf KZN AI golf performance platform, now purchasable on the company website.
Company moved GameGolf KZN AI from limited release to full commercial availability for purchase at gamegolf.com.
Platform integrates automatic shot tracking, advanced GPS, AI analytics and personalized performance insights.
Service leverages existing assets: over 36,000 mapped courses and an estimated 300 million shots recorded historically.
Company notes potential risks including manufacturing, support, product performance, regulatory approvals and subscriber conversion.
